_about: The house voice, in one place (Oct 14, 2026). voiceover.py and voice_take.py read this file; it overrides ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID in .env. Change the voice ONLY here, and only after a dated audition and the owner's ear (see Research Notes/Voice Audition (Oct 14, 2026)/README.md). Command-line flags still override single settings for a test.

primary.name: Alex - Upbeat, Energetic and Clear (ElevenLabs Voice Library)
primary.why: Round 3 audition: 224-229 wpm at speed 1.2 (the old hits ran 206-252), the most pitch and loudness variety of the steady voices, numbers +0.9 dB over other words, every test name heard right, the most consistent take to take (0.99). Library terms: rate 1.0, notice period 90 days, already in My Voices.

backup.name: pham v2 (our own clone of the old Shorts' narration), fixed settings
backup.why: Owned by the account, so it can't be withdrawn. At these settings it reads 224-232 wpm and sits closer to the old narration (0.969) than the old production settings did (0.95, at 265 wpm). Use it if Alex is withdrawn or the owner prefers the old voice.

clone_legacy.name: pham v2, the Oct 5-14 production settings (kept only for re-renders of old packages)
